safety: Only local files and loopback fixtures were used. Fresh browser profiles denied all external requests without DNS lookup or forwarding. Threat matching used synthetic DNR inputs, never requests to those hosts.

correctedHarnessAttempts.cause: The Firefox evaluator required a single expression; the two local test scripts were wrapped in one IIFE.
The navigation probe returned no stored record. It now initializes its state before leaving and captures diagnostic stage/error fields; the final trusted pagehide check passes.

limitations: This is a bounded subset of procedural filters, not full uBO parity.
Native selector calls cannot be preempted; elapsed-time budgets are checked between operations.
Live YouTube, Twitch, Google, Fandom and anti-blocker behavior were not tested in this increment.
No arbitrary scriptlets, network regex filters, element picker or automatic list updater.
Reported-threat policy and its 2026-11-30T00:00:00Z expiry are unchanged.
